sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "firms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = lower(id) AND length(id) = 36), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT, "logo_blob" BLOB, "number_grouping" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pk' CHECK (number_grouping IN ('pk', 'western')), "show_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "default_country_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '92', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = lower(id) AND length(id) = 36), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "firm_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = lower(id) AND length(id) = 36), "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES firms(id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'manager', 'clerk')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_members_live ON firm_members (firm_id, user_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = lower(id) AND length(id) = 36), "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES firms(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "short_code" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(short_code) = 4), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_devices_code ON devices (firm_id, short_code)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = lower(id) AND length(id) = 36), "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES firms(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_normalized" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_bag_weight_g" INTEGER CHECK (default_bag_weight_g IS NULL OR default_bag_weight_g > 0), "default_rate_base_weight_g" INTEGER CHECK (default_rate_base_weight_g IS NULL OR default_rate_base_weight_g > 0), "default_uom" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg' CHECK (default_uom IN ('kg', 'unit')), "track_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "created_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, UNIQUE(firm_id, id));
CREATE INDEX idx_items_name ON items (firm_id, name_normalized)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = lower(id) AND length(id) = 36), "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES firms(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_normalized" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT, "phone_normalized" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "created_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), "merged_into_id" TEXT REFERENCES customers(id), "needs_review" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, UNIQUE(firm_id, id));
CREATE INDEX idx_customers_name ON customers (firm_id, name_normalized)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_customers_phone ON customers (firm_id, phone_normalized) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND merged_into_id IS NULL AND phone_normalized IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = lower(id) AND length(id) = 36), "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES firms(id), "customer_id" TEXT, "device_short_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (display_seq > 0), "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('sale', 'purchase', 'cash_in', 'cash_out', 'opening_balance', 'adjustment')), "entry_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entry_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "description" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version >= 1), "calculated_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "overridden_total" INTEGER, "overridden_total_basis" INTEGER, "final_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "signed_amount" INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE type WHEN 'sale' THEN final_amount WHEN 'cash_out' THEN final_amount WHEN 'opening_balance' THEN final_amount WHEN 'adjustment' THEN final_amount WHEN 'purchase' THEN -final_amount WHEN 'cash_in' THEN -final_amount END) STORED, "created_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), "updated_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, UNIQUE(firm_id, id), FOREIGN KEY(firm_id, customer_id)REFERENCES customers(firm_id, id), CHECK((type = 'adjustment' AND final_amount <> 0)OR(type <> 'adjustment' AND final_amount > 0)));
CREATE INDEX idx_txn_balance ON transactions (firm_id, customer_id, signed_amount) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_txn_ledger ON transactions (firm_id, customer_id, entry_date, created_at, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_txn_walkin ON transactions (firm_id, entry_date) WHERE customer_id IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_txn_display ON transactions (firm_id, device_short_code, display_seq)
CREATE INDEX idx_txn_updated ON transactions (firm_id, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = lower(id) AND length(id) = 36), "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_no >= 0), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "uom" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg' CHECK (uom IN ('kg', 'unit')), "sale_mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (sale_mode IN ('by_bags', 'by_weight', 'by_count')), "bag_count" INTEGER CHECK (bag_count IS NULL OR bag_count > 0), "bag_weight_g" INTEGER CHECK (bag_weight_g IS NULL OR bag_weight_g > 0), "total_weight_g" INTEGER CHECK (total_weight_g IS NULL OR total_weight_g > 0), "quantity" INTEGER CHECK (quantity IS NULL OR quantity > 0), "rate_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rate_paisa > 0), "rate_base_weight_g" INTEGER CHECK (rate_base_weight_g IS NULL OR rate_base_weight_g > 0), "overridden_total" INTEGER, "calculated_total" INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE uom WHEN 'kg' THEN(rate_paisa * total_weight_g + rate_base_weight_g / 2)/ rate_base_weight_g WHEN 'unit' THEN rate_paisa * quantity END) STORED, "final_amount" INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (COALESCE(overridden_total, calculated_total)) STORED, FOREIGN KEY(firm_id, transaction_id)REFERENCES transactions(firm_id, id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(firm_id, item_id)REFERENCES items(firm_id, id), CHECK((sale_mode = 'by_bags')=(bag_count IS NOT NULL AND bag_weight_g IS NOT NULL)), CHECK((uom = 'kg')=(total_weight_g IS NOT NULL AND rate_base_weight_g IS NOT NULL)), CHECK((uom = 'unit')=(quantity IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_lines_no ON transaction_lines (firm_id, transaction_id, line_no)
CREATE INDEX idx_lines_item ON transaction_lines (firm_id, item_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = lower(id) AND length(id) = 36), "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('edit', 'delete', 'sync_overwrite', 'restore')), "changed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "changed_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_by_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(firm_id, transaction_id)REFERENCES transactions(firm_id, id)ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE INDEX idx_history_txn ON transaction_history (firm_id, transaction_id, changed_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "print_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = lower(id) AND length(id) = 36), "firm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT, "customer_id" TEXT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('slip', 'ledger', 'export_pdf', 'export_png')), "printed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "printed_balance_after" INTEGER, "range_from" TEXT, "range_to" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX idx_print_txn ON print_log (firm_id, transaction_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "queued_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "failed_reason" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(target_table, row_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_orphans" ("target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "missing_parent_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "missing_parent_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(target_table, row_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "last_pull_cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "clock_offset_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hlc_last" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_sync_at" INTEGER, "paused_reason" TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE VIEW customer_balances AS SELECT firm_id, customer_id, SUM(signed_amount) AS balance FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY firm_id, customer_id
